preconditions.expression: isinstance(prophesy, str) and len(prophesy) > 0 and len(prophesy) <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The prophesy is a non-empty string with length at most 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() or c == '-' for c in prophesy)
preconditions.description: The prophesy consists only of digits and hyphens.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(stdout, str) and stdout.strip() == stdout and len(stdout.split()) == 1
postconditions.description: The output is a single line containing exactly one date string with no leading or trailing whitespace.
The output date is a valid date according to the rules (year 2013-2015, valid month, valid day for that month).

postconditions.expression: count_occurrences(prophesy, stdout.strip()) > max((count_occurrences(prophesy, d) for d in all_valid_dates() if d != stdout.strip()), default=-1)
postconditions.description: The output date has a strictly greater number of occurrences in the prophesy than any other valid date.
